root_cause.text: The metalist was stored in the per-action `tcf_ife_info` structure instead of the per-params RCU-protected `tcf_ife_params` structure, so during a replace operation new metadata was appended to the existing list without replacing it, causing unbounded growth and eventual out-of-bounds write in `ife_tlv_meta_encode`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states: "whenever an ife action replace changes the metalist, instead of replacing the old data on the metalist, the current ife code is appending the new metadata." The patch moves the `metalist` field from `struct tcf_ife_info` to `struct tcf_ife_params` and adjusts all functions (e.g., `__add_metainfo`, `populate_metalist`, `_tcf_ife_cleanup` renamed to `__tcf_ife_cleanup`) to operate on the params' metalist, ensuring that each new params has its own fresh list. The KASAN trace confirms a slab-out-of-bounds write in `ife_tlv_meta_encode` at offset `0x...ffe`.

candidates.rationale: The metalist is stored in tcf_ife_info, not in the per-params RCU-protected tcf_ife_params. This prevents proper replacement on a replace operation, causing unbounded growth.
This unconditionally appends new metadata to the existing list without clearing it first, leading to accumulation of old metadata on each replace operation.
The list is only initialized on creation, not on replace. Without resetting the list, new metadata is added to the existing list, exacerbating unbounded growth.
This call on a replace operation (exists=true) adds metadata to the existing list via add_metainfo, which appends without clearing, directly causing unbounded growth.
Similar to populate_metalist, this adds all metadata modules to the existing list on replace, contributing to unbounded growth when no explicit metalist is provided.

bic_trace_step.reason: In `tcf_ife_init`, when overriding an existing action (ovr=1), the code reuses the existing `tcf_ife_info` structure without reinitializing the `metalist`. The `INIT_LIST_HEAD(&ife->metalist)` is only called when `ret == ACT_P_CREATED`, i.e., for new actions. On subsequent replaces, `populate_metalist` calls `list_add_tail` on the old list, causing unbounded growth of metadata entries. This matches the described root cause of unbounded growth leading to out-of-bounds write in `ife_tlv_meta_encode`.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the IFE action with the metalist stored directly in tcf_ife_info. In tcf_ife_init, when an existing action is replaced (the else branch after tcf_hash_check), the metalist is not cleared before new metadata is added via populate_metalist or use_all_metadata. This causes the list to grow unboundedly on each replace, leading to the out-of-bounds write vulnerability described. The code lacks any fix to reset or protect the list on replace.
